Use of Calculators — Estimates Only

All results provided by our calculators are estimates for planning purposes only. While we make every effort to ensure the accuracy of our formulas and material constants, actual material quantities may vary due to:

  • Variations in material density by product, brand, region, and moisture content
  • Measurement inaccuracies in your project dimensions
  • Site-specific conditions such as uneven ground, compaction, or settling
  • Differences between pallet sizes or bag yields from specific suppliers

Always confirm final quantities with your local supplier before ordering. For large or structural projects, consult a qualified professional.
